integrity: The finite exact arithmetic program was run from this package and its output checked; generality relies on the written analytical proof. No external or independent mathematical validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive conductance on exactly one existing edge of a primitive strongly regular graph, one scalar actuator; no assertion about multi-input, imprimitive, or other perturbations. Finite test instances corroborate but do not establish the infinite-class theorem. Related 2017 edge-perturbation spectral results are acknowledged; implicit equivalent coverage remains possible.
title: Exact one-edge controllability ranks in primitive strongly regular networks
